publicReleaseNotes:
An update from the latest published release, v0.4.31. This release updates the restore and setup experience, improves imports from Zendesk, connected mailboxes and older HappyToHelp workspaces, and fixes several day-to-day support workflows.

- **Installation and restore:** pins rer 0.2.127 and refreshes the Base copies to `c21583b3`. Restore a hosted export into a native destination. The post-restore journey uses the native owner session to check readiness and guide the owner back into the restored installation.
- **Setup and Cutover:** the managed-install guide explains how to repeat the start command to reopen a copy and how to restart a local checkout after changing settings. Setup marks the email-to-yourself check unavailable when local outbound mail is off and leaves it out of the progress count. The email and widget cards in Cutover link directly to the live-mail and local widget check guides.
- **Zendesk fidelity:** Move in accepts documented JSON arrays and API collections alongside newline-delimited exports. Numeric fields follow their source definitions and reject values that cannot be represented exactly. Imports retain primary phone numbers and the supported ticket-to-requester, requester-to-company and message-to-supplied-file links. The field ledger and review explain what came across, where source warnings came from, and what remains source-only, including followers, satisfaction history, extra company memberships and unsupported field types. Collect every needed API page and supply attachment bytes before importing.
- **Mailbox history and legacy imports:** read selected Gmail, Microsoft 365 or IMAP folders into a private Move in review without turning on live mail. Imported history stays out of customer views and Reports. The legacy package flow brings historical conversations, supported files, help articles and saved replies into a separate workspace. It retains source attribution and can match an old assignee to one current teammate. Old credentials and access stay behind, and AI, mail and old automatic work start off or paused. Large import undo now reports progress and identifies records that block reversal.
- **Widget and account access:** Setup confirms widget website changes and makes the steps for trying the widget clearer. The public widget explains when chat is unavailable. Local owners can re-enter Setup and choose a password without entering the generated starter password. Teammates land in the inbox after accepting an invitation. Invitation copy confirmations keep the private link out of announcements, and a clipboard failure offers an explicit way to reveal it for manual copying.
- **Inbox, AI and workspace fixes:** bulk replies stay within the database statement budget, and AI reply usage is reported for the selected workspace. Workspace creation opens Setup for the new workspace. Ticket-reference search respects the current workspace and access rules. Workflow scheduling gives clearer time-zone guidance, and delegation setup shows the developer values for the selected workspace.
- **Public and contributor documentation:** the guides explain connected-app setup, how to reach support through the Help Center, and how contributors install locked dependencies and run repository checks with Node 22.20.0 and pnpm 10.12.4. The release also carries test-only updates and Verify shard balancing. Those are not user-visible changes.
- **Migrations:** the 200 SQL files are byte-identical to v0.4.31. No new migration step is required for this upgrade.
